$comment: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for daily-orbit.
Used by: (1) cwl-query.py for CLI access, (2) CDK stack for saved queries in the Console.
Docker JSON       → { log: '<pino json>', stream: 'stdout', time: '<iso>' }
Pino JSON         → { level, time, pid, hostname, msg, ... }
HTTP requests have: module, method, path, status, durationMs
App events have:    error?, stage?, runId?, localPath?
CloudWatch auto-parses the Docker layer, so 'log' is a top-level field.
The Pino JSON inside 'log' must be extracted with regex parse statements.
IMPORTANT: use 'display' not 'fields' after parse — 'fields' conflicts.
parsePrefix: parse log /"level":(?<lvl>\d+)/ | parse log /"time":"(?<ts>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/
parseHttp: parse log /"method":"(?<method>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"path":"(?<path>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"status":(?<status>\d+)/ | parse log /"durationMs":(?<dur>\d+)/
parseAppEvent: parse log /"error":"(?<error>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"stage":"(?<stage>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"runId":"(?<runId>[^"]+)"/

errors.query: parse log /"level":(?<lvl>\d+)/ | parse log /"time":"(?<ts>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"error":"(?<error>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"stage":"(?<stage>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"runId":"(?<runId>[^"]+)"/ | filter lvl >= 40 | display ts, lvl, msg, error, stage, runId | sort ts desc | limit 200

slow.query: parse log /"level":(?<lvl>\d+)/ | parse log /"time":"(?<ts>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"method":"(?<method>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"path":"(?<path>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"status":(?<status>\d+)/ | parse log /"durationMs":(?<dur>\d+)/ | filter dur > 500 | display ts, method, path, status, dur | sort dur desc | limit 100

status-codes.description: Request count by HTTP status code
status-codes.query: parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"status":(?<status>\d+)/ | filter msg = "request" | stats count(*) as cnt by status | sort cnt desc

top-paths.description: Most-hit API paths with latency stats
top-paths.query: parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"path":"(?<path>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"durationMs":(?<dur>\d+)/ | filter msg = "request" | stats count(*) as cnt, avg(dur) as avg_ms, max(dur) as max_ms by path | sort cnt desc | limit 50

path.query: parse log /"time":"(?<ts>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"method":"(?<method>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"path":"(?<path>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"status":(?<status>\d+)/ | parse log /"durationMs":(?<dur>\d+)/ | filter path like "{arg}" | display ts, method, path, status, dur | sort ts desc | limit 200

search.description: Free-text search across all log messages (pass --arg <text>)
search.query: parse log /"level":(?<lvl>\d+)/ | parse log /"time":"(?<ts>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"method":"(?<method>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"path":"(?<path>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"status":(?<status>\d+)/ | parse log /"error":"(?<error>[^"]+)"/ | filter log like "{arg}" | display ts, lvl, msg, method, path, status, error | sort ts desc | limit 200

non-http.query: parse log /"level":(?<lvl>\d+)/ | parse log /"time":"(?<ts>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"error":"(?<error>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"stage":"(?<stage>[^"]+)"/ | parse log /"runId":"(?<runId>[^"]+)"/ | filter msg not like "request" | display ts, lvl, msg, error, stage, runId | sort ts desc | limit 200

traffic.query: parse log /"msg":"(?<msg>[^"]+)"/ | filter msg = "request" | stats count(*) as requests by bin(5m) | sort bin(5m) asc
